messages:
Maya L.: quick heads-up — PR #14209 (feature/batching-fix) is ready for review/merge but CI is being flaky. macOS and wasm matrix failed the last 2 runs. Need to land before Wed 03:00 UTC freeze. Can we get a short merge slot or advice on whether to hold? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/14209 :eyes:
Jake R.: can you paste the failing job links + short failing log? I can kick macos reruns. @oncall-bot can you queue macos and wasm reruns? :mag:
oncall-bot: Rerun requested by Jake R. — queued jobs: macos-12-x86_64, wasm-integration. Estimated queue time ~6m.
Priya S.: fwiw I can reserve a 30m rebase window Tue 22:30–23:00 UTC if we want to land before the freeze, but we'll need clean CI. Also I saw the wasm flake earlier — looks like a timeout rather than a correctness failure. Might be OK to bump timeout for that job.
Maya L.: thanks. failing job: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/main/builds/98765#fail — snippet:
```
error: test_timeout on wasm_integration
thread 'tokio-runtime' panicked at 'deadline reached', tests/common.rs:42:10
```
If macos rerun is green and wasm still times out, I'll try a local repro + quick test.
release-coordinator: FYI deploy freeze Wed 03:00 UTC. Please aim to land by 01:30 UTC to allow canary verification. If CI is green by 23:45 UTC tonight I'll hold a 30m slot.
Jake R.: on it — watching reruns. If macos passes and wasm still fails once, I can kick wasm rerun with increased timeout env. If it still flakes twice, recommend postponing.
oncall-bot: Rerun complete — macos-12-x86_64: ✅ passed; wasm-integration: ❌ failed (timeout).
Priya S.: can we try changing the wasm job to `WASM_TIMEOUT=120` for a run? I'll open a tiny job-config PR if that's easiest. That should be low risk and probably fixes the flaky wall-clock dependent test.
Maya L.: if Priya opens the config PR, can someone do quick approvals so we can re-run CI and land? I'll hold off rebasing until we see that result.
release-coordinator: yes — prefer config tweak + green CI over skipping tests. If Priya posts the PR, ping me and I'll prioritize a quick review.
Jake R.: I'll reserve the 23:00 UTC rebase slot tentatively. If we get green CI after the config PR I'll merge during that slot.
Maya L.: executing `./scripts/ci/retry-failed.sh --jobs wasm-integration` now, will post any output. :computer:
oncall-bot: Retry started by Maya L. — wasm-integration queued with env override `WASM_TIMEOUT=120`. ETA ~4m.
noncall-bot: Retry finished — wasm-integration: ✅ passed.
Priya S.: nice, sounds good. I pushed the tiny job-config PR to bump the timeout (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/201). Opened with small changelog.
Maya L.: perfect — CI is green across matrix. I'm going to rebase then merge during Jake's reserved 23:00 UTC slot. Thanks everyone for the quick help :rocket:
Jake R.: will watch and do a post-merge smoke. If anything odd, we'll rollback the canary.
release-coordinator: slot confirmed for 23:00 UTC. Please ping here when merged so I can start monitoring rollout. Good job team :thumbsup:
